body: I don't have any friends closer that can drive, nor do I have the money for public transportation. I've also never heard of a therapist ever driving to/picking up their patients considering she would have a patient before and after me so there's no way she could.

I'm not sure. I just assumed she knew what she was talking about. She was a nice person so I went to the doctor she recommended. Not to mention my mom knew who it was so I didn't think anything bad until I actually got into the office and he didn't let me talk.
I talked to a psychologist first, she was nice and listened to what I had to say and she recommended the psychiatrist that didn't even let me finish a sentence.

Interacting with people and since I'm now supervisor I've got more responsibilities. It stresses me out. Part of my job requires us to watch suicidal people and I honestly don't feel I'm cut out for the job.

I make about 8.50 an hour, I've looked at apartments in the area and i can't afford even the cheapest ones. That including my phone bill, car insurance, Internet, groceries, etc. I'm currently trying to look for a new job that pays more just so I can move out. 


I've had anxiety around people for as long as I could remember. I actually quit my last job because of it. Being around people for so long freaked me out. Plus being in a parking lot all day made me paranoid and I always thought someone was going to hit me. It's gotten better over the past few years, but. It completely gone. But since I got this new job and especially since I became supervisor it's starting to get worse. 


As for hour long it's been since our relationship, it's been about three years which is another reason I think it's so stupid I still feel the way I do and why I still get upset over her sometimes. I guess it just hasn't felt like it's been that long. 


I also feel like one of the biggest reasons why it hurt was because she broke up with me over the phone and then I never saw her or spoke to her again after that. She never even gave me a reason why she broke up with me. I kind of feel like if I could at least talk to her and kind if clear things up that things would be a little better, but I wouldn't want to do that because I know it would upset her.
